scope: Eight purposively selected complete prose paragraphs from four qualitative/ethnographic papers across intimate-partner privacy, game labor, ICTD and material sustainability. Descriptive exemplars, not representative norms or targets.

normalization: remove hyphen plus line break between ASCII letter and lowercase ASCII letter
collapse whitespace to one ASCII space; strip ends
extraction.token_caveat: Operational ASCII alphanumeric token count; includes citation numbers, keeps internal apostrophes/hyphens, not linguistic word segmentation. Embedded quotations count as tokens. Complete paragraph prose retained; P33 p19 run-in question heading excluded. PDF extraction may fuse words (e.g. source line-wrap compounds); counts deliberately describe normalized pdftotext output, not manually reconstructed typeset prose. P39 p4 uses two character spans to exclude an interleaved running header; P37 stops before interleaved opposite-column paragraphs.
extraction.offset_unit: Python Unicode character offsets in normalized page, end exclusive
